result.final:
Qatar Airways Economy baggage allowance depends on your fare and route:

- **Checked baggage, most routes:** Economy Lite **20 kg (44 lb)**, Classic **25 kg (55 lb)**, Convenience **30 kg (66 lb)**, Comfort **35 kg (77 lb)**.
- **Checked baggage, flights to/from Africa or the Americas:** Lite **1 bag up to 23 kg (50 lb)**; Classic, Convenience and Comfort **2 bags up to 23 kg (50 lb) each**.
- **Carry-on:** **1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb)**. For flights to or from Brazil, the Economy carry-on limit is **10 kg (22 lb)**.

Your exact checked allowance may vary; Qatar Airways says to check your ticket or booking. [Official baggage allowance](https://www.qatarairways.com/en/baggage/allowance.html). <citation refs="pIdjzLfdvNdBiwioD9NXQ">Economy checked and carry-on allowances</citation>
